summary: Diff adds a new past-attendance sheet with calendar selection, schedule derivation with exchanges, local ClassEvent creation on save, and a daily reminder hook plus persistence/backup support for reminder deduping. However, some requirements are not evidenced in the diff summary: backend API/storage validation for past attendance, notification click-to-open Mark Today, exact reminder body text, and removal of any existing auto-missed/auto-absent behavior. Dashboard button label/placement is also not provable from the provided truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a new Dashboard quick-action button labeled exactly "Mark Past Attendance" directly below "Mark Today's Classes" and wire it to open the past-attendance flow UI.
missing_requirements.reason: HomeDashboardPage.tsx is truncated and does not show the actual button label text nor its placement relative to the existing "Mark Today's Classes" button, so compliance cannot be confirmed from the diff summary alone.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend rejects duplicate saves for the same date for the same caller and returns an error that the frontend maps to exactly: "Attendance already marked for this date"; no duplicate per-date records are created.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend best-effort duplicate blocking is shown, but the backend-side rejection and error signaling are not evidenced in the backend diff snippet (only new types/maps are visible).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend support for storing per-caller per-date attendance-day records (date, per-subject status, timestamp) and validating both "no future dates" and "no duplicate date" rules on save via a shared method.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows new AttendanceDay type and an attendanceDays map keyed by Principal and date-like key, but no shared save method or the future/duplicate validation logic is visible in the provided truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove or disable any existing "auto-mark absent" or automatic missed-attendance penalty behavior so unmarked days cause no automatic events.
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence shows removal/disablement of any existing automatic missed-day handling logic.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (no mention of removing auto-mark absent)

missing_requirements.requirement: Reminder notification Body exactly "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now." (curly apostrophe), sent at most once per calendar day, respecting notification settings.
missing_requirements.reason: Hook sends body text with a straight apostrophe ("haven't") instead of the exact required curly apostrophe ("haven’t").
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useDailyAttendanceReminder.ts (body: "You haven't marked today's attendance. Tap to update now.")

missing_requirements.requirement: Clicking the reminder notification focuses the window and opens the existing "Mark Today's Classes" sheet; fallback to Dashboard with clear message if cannot open.
missing_requirements.reason: sendNotification supports onClick, but useDailyAttendanceReminder does not pass an onClick handler, and there is no shown wiring to open the Mark Today sheet from notification clicks or a fallback message/navigation.
evidence: frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx (truncated; no notification click integration shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide clear English feedback for notification-disabled/unsupported/permission denied cases (where relevant) and not silently fail.
missing_requirements.reason: sendNotification returns detailed failure reasons/messages, but useDailyAttendanceReminder does not surface these failures via toast/alert, so user-facing messaging for these notification error states is not evidenced.
